meta.title: General Automatic Memory
meta.description: Cross-tool, human-editable, self-indexing long-term memory with a fixed token budget.

panel.title: Memory
panel.empty: No memories yet. Tell the agent something worth remembering, or import from another tool.
panel.hostUnavailable: Host routes unavailable. Tools and slash commands still work.

import.hint: Bring in memory files and past conversations from other agents. Scan is read-only; a snapshot is taken before applying.

timeline.hint: Shows memories valid on that date (validFrom ≤ date < invalidatedAt) — answers “why did the agent decide that back then”.

graph.empty: No relations yet. Say “X owns Y” and one will be created.

audit.empty: No audit records for this day.

recovery.diff: Diff of the two latest snapshots
recovery.noSnapshots: No snapshots yet (created automatically before import/consolidation)

settings.hint: These values come from the dsh profile (cordis.patch.yml). Edit them in dsh Plugins / Settings; this view is read-only.
settings.projectionHint: Export memory into formats other tools read. Off by default — the value of this plugin is importing in, not sharing out.
